critique: The render strongly captures the Classic Fractal character: a dense black-field particle lattice, thin flowing string contours, bright caustic-like crossings, and substantial organic evolution between frames. The central circular void/field feature also remains coherently placed through the motion. The main visible compromise is color: the result is largely white/gray-blue, so it lacks the richer cool-blue separation and tonal depth associated with the preset thumbnail; the brightest contours clip toward white and flatten the particle detail.

suggestions.why: Use a more saturated cool-blue particle color so the dense fractal strands retain blue tonal identity instead of reading predominantly white/gray.
